gaps.title: No approved Generation knowledge release
gaps.whyItMatters: The packaged release (dam catalog, source-access list) carries no approval record, so the runtime abstains (BLOCKED_AWAITING_APPROVED_RELEASE).
gaps.bowfisherDecision: Whether any release or schedule may be shown at all.
gaps.stopCondition: Stop when Michael records an approval for a named release, or rejects it.
gaps.expectedOutput: An approval record and a new APPROVED release id.

gaps.title: CWMS release series not bound for USACE and CWMS-published projects
gaps.whyItMatters: About 200 dam lakes have an allowed official source (CWMS) whose outflow / turbine / spill series ids are not yet bound; until a probe binds them those lakes are DISCOVERY_PENDING.
gaps.bowfisherDecision: Whether the Generation tile can show measured release on USACE lakes.
gaps.stopCondition: Stop when every pending CWMS lake is bound with an exact tsid or recorded as publishing no release series.
gaps.expectedOutput: Reviewed bindings in a new catalog version.

gaps.title: RISE release items not bound for Reclamation reservoirs
gaps.whyItMatters: 65 Reclamation lakes (plus RISE-covered others) need their release item id from the RISE catalog.
gaps.bowfisherDecision: Whether Western reservoirs show measured release.
gaps.stopCondition: Stop when each is bound or recorded as having no observed release item.

gaps.title: TVA LocationIDs not evidenced for 7 TVA-API lakes; USGS tailwater gauges not located
gaps.whyItMatters: Kentucky Lake, Fontana, Hiwassee, Cherokee, Chickamauga and Laurel River need TVA /locations resolution; lakes run by operators without public release data need a downstream USGS discharge gauge where one exists.
gaps.stopCondition: Stop when each lake is bound or recorded as having no gauge.
gaps.expectedOutput: Records and bindings in a new catalog version.

gaps.title: TVA robots.txt and the iOS 'TVA blocks automated access' note; SWPA (energy.gov) robots.txt and terms
gaps.whyItMatters: The owner rule allows documented official services; a page whose robots.txt or terms forbid automated use needs permission first.
gaps.bowfisherDecision: Whether TVA and SWPA schedules may be read.
gaps.stopCondition: Stop when both are read and recorded, or permission is requested.
gaps.expectedOutput: source_access.json statuses confirmed in a new release.

gaps.title: Published release picture not yet compared with the operators' published schedules
gaps.whyItMatters: The pre-registered week-long comparison is the validation gate before any customer use.
gaps.bowfisherDecision: Whether the tile can be trusted.
gaps.stopCondition: Stop after the pre-registered week, PASS or FAIL against the pre-declared thresholds.
